## Welcome
My name is Hyder Said, and I am a gastroenterologist and advanced inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) fellow at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai. I am also pursuing a Master of Science in Clinical Research at Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health. My research focuses on sleep, circadian rhythms, and gut-brain interactions in IBD. I study how wearable technology, behavioral interventions, and medication timing can improve symptoms, quality of life, and treatment outcomes.
